_uitleg: Room cards (no prices) and pop-up content for the 'Hotel near ...' search pages, English. Same shape as content/zoek-kamers-de.json; photos, videos and Mews room ids from content/uitje-kamers-nl.json; texts translated by Claude from the Dutch on 11 Nov 2026.

comfort.kort: For guests on the move who mainly want a good night's sleep and set off rested in the morning.
comfort.desc: A comfortable, modern room for a relaxed stay in North Limburg. Whether you come for a short break or on business, the Comfort room is an easy place to feel at home.
tekst: A comfortable, modern room for a relaxed stay in North Limburg. Whether you come for a short break or on business, the Comfort room is an easy place to feel at home.
The room has two single beds, a private bathroom with shower and a seating area with comfortable chairs.

comfort-3.kort: Travelling as three? Then you end the evening together in one room.
comfort-3.desc: The Comfort room for three offers extra space for families or friends travelling together, with everything you need for an easy stay in green North Limburg.
tekst: The Comfort room for three offers extra space for families or friends travelling together, with everything you need for an easy stay in green North Limburg.
Three single beds, a private bathroom and a pleasant seating area make this room a good fit for travelling together.
kenmerken: Private bathroom with shower and/or bath

mindervalide.kort: Set up for wheelchair users, with extra-wide doors and an adapted bathroom.
mindervalide.desc: This adapted room is designed for guests with limited mobility. The restaurant and terrace are wheelchair-friendly too, so you can enjoy dinner during your stay without worries.
tekst: This adapted room is designed for guests with limited mobility. The restaurant and terrace are wheelchair-friendly too, so you can enjoy dinner during your stay without worries.
A spacious layout, extra-wide doors and an adapted bathroom give comfort and independence.
kenmerken: Sofa bed for extra sleeping space
Extra-wide doors and room for a wheelchair or walker
Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs

royale.kort: A weekend away, with time to unpack and simply be there.
royale.desc: The Royale rooms are larger than the Comfort rooms and give you that little bit extra: more space and a comfortable seating area.
tekst: The Royale rooms are larger than the Comfort rooms and give you that little bit extra: more space and a comfortable seating area.
Choose a double bed or twin beds and enjoy the extra room and a private bathroom with shower or bath.
kenmerken: Double bed or twin beds (2 single beds)
Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs
Private bathroom with shower and/or bath

deluxe.kort: After a day out, step into your own sauna and let the day slip away.
deluxe.desc: The Deluxe rooms have a private infrared sauna in the bathroom, which makes them a good choice if you want to unwind properly: a small wellness experience in your own room.
tekst: The Deluxe rooms have a private infrared sauna in the bathroom, which makes them a good choice if you want to unwind properly: a small wellness experience in your own room.
Next to your own sauna you have a comfortable seating area and everything within easy reach.
kenmerken: Double bed or twin beds (2 single beds)

suite.kort: To celebrate an anniversary or birthday, with a night you will talk about later.
suite.desc: Our most spacious room, with a private infrared sauna, a large seating area and everything within easy reach: a place to fully unwind.
tekst: Our most spacious room, with a private infrared sauna, a large seating area and everything within easy reach: a place to fully unwind.
A king-size bed and a sofa bed offer room for up to four people.
kenmerken: Sofa bed for extra sleeping space
Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs

bruidssuite.kort: After the big day, or simply an evening for the two of you: run the bath and slow down.
bruidssuite.desc: The Bridal suite is made for special moments. Whether you have just got married or are celebrating a romantic weekend, enjoy the calm and the warm atmosphere together.
tekst: The Bridal suite is made for special moments. Whether you have just got married or are celebrating a romantic weekend, enjoy the calm and the warm atmosphere together.
A freestanding bath, a large walk-in shower and bathrobes with slippers complete the stay.
kenmerken: Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs

winter.sub: Two nights, arrival from 1 December 2026 to 31 March 2027
winter.desc: Two nights in a Comfort room with breakfast on both mornings and a three-course dinner on the evening of arrival. The wellness area on the Top Floor is included during your stay.
incl: Two nights with breakfast
Three-course dinner on the evening of arrival
Welcome drink: house wine or specialty beer
Bathrobe and slippers
Wellness during your stay
Early check-in and late check-out (subject to availability)

wellness.sub: One night in a Comfort room, for two people
wellness.desc: One night in a Comfort room with free access to the wellness area on the Top Floor: four saunas, steam cabin, plunge and herbal bath and a relaxation room. In the evening a three-course dinner with regional produce, the next morning the breakfast buffet.
incl: One night in a Comfort room
Welcome drink: a bottle of Botega
Bathrobe, slippers and towel set
Free access to the wellness area (300 m²)
Three-course dinner with regional produce
Extensive breakfast buffet

najaar.sub: Deluxe room for two people, bookable until 30 November
najaar.desc: You are welcomed with coffee or tea and a slice of Limburg vlaai and stay in a Deluxe room with its own infrared sauna. In the evening a three-course seasonal dinner, the next morning the breakfast buffet.
incl: Welcome with coffee or tea and Limburg vlaai
Deluxe room with private infrared sauna
Three-course seasonal dinner
Extensive breakfast buffet

oorlogsmuseum.sub: One night in a Comfort room, for two people
oorlogsmuseum.desc: One night in a Comfort room with admission to Oorlogsmuseum Overloon (the Overloon War Museum) and coffee or tea in the museum café. In the evening a three-course dinner, the next morning the breakfast buffet. Let us know the day of your museum visit and we reserve your tickets.
incl: One night in a Comfort room
Admission to Oorlogsmuseum Overloon
Coffee or tea in the museum café
Welcome letter and a small gift from the museum in your room
Three-course dinner
Breakfast buffet

wellness.desc: The 300 m² wellness area is on the Top Floor of the hotel: four saunas (walnut, forest cabin, salt stone and infrared), steam cabin, experience showers, plunge and herbal bath, four foot baths and a relaxation room. Swimwear is not allowed, except on Tuesdays (swimwear day). Hotel guests pay € 12.50 per person; reserve your time in advance at reception.
